writeup: Spartan's Javelin bipod Universal Picatinny Adapter is $9.99 new at Woot. Spartan's own store, The Happy Antelope and Hunt G4 all charge $29.99 for the same Classic adapter (SKU SP02-02-R). It's CNC-machined 7075 aluminum, weighs about 1.1 oz and takes up just 20mm of rail, so you can snap a Javelin bipod onto any Picatinny-equipped rifle.
